verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party twoFactor plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup as the default method, plus email/SMS OTP, backup code generation for account recovery, enabling/disabling 2FA and trusted-device management. That covers the core MFA story. Nothing in the evidence shows that MFA can be mandated for all users or that step-up re-authentication can be enforced on sensitive actions. missing for 10: documented policy to require MFA for users, step-up enforcement for sensitive operations, independent hands-on corroboration of the 2FA flow
